claims.claim: You must be widowed to inherit State Pension.
claims.quote: You might be able to inherit an extra payment on top of your new State Pension if you’re widowed.
claims.note: The text makes being widowed the basis for inheriting.

claims.claim: You must have been widowed before reaching your own State Pension age.
claims.note: The text does not make being widowed before your own State Pension age a condition; it only says remarrying before State Pension age stops you inheriting and that you inherit when widowed or when you claim, whichever is later.
None of the readable sources mention a death certificate.

claims.claim: You need the National Insurance numbers of both you and your late spouse or civil partner.
claims.note: The sources do not list National Insurance numbers as something you must provide.
